title: 19 September 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles’ 38th lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club took place on this day.

The group’s lunchtime shows typically lasted from 12-2pm. This was their 53rd known appearance overall at the soon-to-be-famous cellar venue on Mathew Street.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows. Their final performance at the venue took place on 3 August 1963.
